summary: BioMarin filed an 8-K to report the completion of its acquisition of Amicus Therapeutics for $14.50 per share in cash, valuing the transaction at an implied enterprise value of approximately $4.9 billion (based on Amicus's fully diluted shares). The deal, announced December 19, 2025, closed on April 27, 2026, with Amicus merging into a BioMarin subsidiary. All Amicus common shares, in-the-money options, RSUs, and performance RSUs were cancelled and converted into cash. The board recommended the merger; financial advisors were not named. The all-cash consideration eliminates deal spread risk. Watch for post-close integration updates and combined pipeline developments.
